scope: Sant Pau transport resilience only. The Sant Pau collector now uses a 20-second default board timeout and one retry instead of the shared three-retry behavior, preventing a slow board from blocking production for several minutes. Parser logic, pagination, Full-JD requirements, scoring V1.37, thresholds, weights, Spain-only geography, source count, Madrid V1.89 fallback, seen-state semantics, reporting, Telegram and all other collectors are unchanged.
